result.reason: The clause adopts New York law and New York County courts, but it does not cleanly establish exclusive court jurisdiction because it retains language allowing an arbitrator’s award to be confirmed in any competent state or federal court, including outside New York County. It also duplicates the jurisdiction provision and leaves a fragment beginning with “(b),” producing an internally inconsistent and poorly integrated dispute-resolution clause. The unrelated severability terms and general commercial intent are otherwise preserved.
